name: Dalaran Status Report
summary: The Dalaran Status Report is a cache of sensitive intelligence compiled by the Kirin Tor wizards stationed at Ambermill in Silverpine Forest. It details the current state of the rebuilding city of Dalaran, making it a prized document for the Forsaken and the Deathstalkers of Undercity.

sections.title: Eyes on the Rebuilding City
sections.body: The Scourge sacked Dalaran and Archimonde brought down its towering spires during the Third War. Its surviving magi are rebuilding the city, and in Forever they lowered its protective shield while reconstruction was still underway. The Kirin Tor also maintains enclaves such as Ambermill in southeastern Silverpine Forest. The Dalaran Status Report contains intelligence about the state of Dalaran sought by the Deathstalkers.

sections.title: A Deathstalker's Test
sections.body: Control of Lordaeron requires absolute vigilance, and Lord Varimathras keeps a keen eye on any remnants of the Alliance and Kirin Tor. After Forsaken interrogators squeezed admissions from a Kirin Tor captive, the dreadlord ordered the Deathstalkers to acquire the status report. Hidden away within a locked strongbox deep inside Ambermill, the document became both an operational necessity and a rite of passage for newly initiated rogues mastering the craft of lockpicking under Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.

faq.q: What is the Dalaran Status Report?
faq.answer: It is a set of confidential Kirin Tor documents outlining the current conditions, recovery operations, and status of Dalaran, compiled by the mages maintaining the outpost of Ambermill.

aliases: how to find the status report
faq.answer: The mages of Ambermill locked the report inside a strongbox within their settlement in southeastern Silverpine Forest, keeping it protected from intruders and curious eyes.

faq.q: Why does the Undercity want this report?
faq.answer: Lord Varimathras and the Forsaken consider the surviving Kirin Tor an active threat on their doorstep. Recovering the report allows the Deathstalkers to assess Dalaran's military strength and secret reconstruction projects.

faq.q: How did the Deathstalkers learn about the document?
faq.answer: The Deathstalkers extracted the document's existence and location directly from a captured Kirin Tor prisoner held and questioned in the Undercity.

angles.text: Mennet Carkad uses the retrieval of this report as a field test for training Deathstalkers in the delicate craft of lockpicking and infiltration against vigilant mages.
The Kirin Tor remnants at Ambermill are a thorn in the side of the Forsaken in Silverpine, making any intelligence on their operations vital to Undercity's security.
